## Summary

What changed, and why is it needed?

## Scope

- Affected categories:
- Affected commands, configs, data, checkpoints, metrics, or documentation:
- Reproducibility claim changed: yes / no

## Validation

List exact commands and results. State clearly whether each run was a unit
test, smoke test, fixed-test evaluation, or complete training run.

```text
command:
result:
hardware (if relevant):
```

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no credentials, private data,
      generated runs, large artifacts, or machine-specific paths.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass, or the reason they could not run is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and manifests match any behavior, config, hash, artifact,
      or reproducibility-boundary change.
- [ ] New or adapted third-party code has source and license information.
- [ ] Data and model files are referenced by immutable revision and checksum
      instead of being committed to Git.
